# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260921-1606-candidate-validation`
- Research system: `ChatGPT Deep Research`
- Started at: `2026-09-21 16:06 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-21 16:11 CDT`
- Research scope: Validate four unresolved candidate pages for Panera Bread, Texas Roadhouse, and SONIC.
- Queue items: `company:brand-panera-bread`, `company:brand-texas-roadhouse`, `company:brand-sonic`
- Methodology: Direct vendor-page validation with product, rollout-scope, recency, and deployment checks.

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 4
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 3
- Conflicts found: 0
- Material takeaway: Panera Bread has strong vendor-reported, executive-quoted evidence for Crunchtime Operations Execution (formerly Zenput) across more than 2,200 U.S. cafes. Texas Roadhouse has strong vendor-reported evidence for a Learning Live mobile training deployment across a 650-location brand family. Restaurant365's SONIC webinar supports only a low-confidence franchisee transition indication, not a brand-wide deployment. A separate Panera webinar preview is a useful negative because it names speakers and generic tools but does not assert Crunchtime use.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1

- Brand: Panera Bread
- Vendor: Crunchtime
- Product or category: Operations Execution (formerly Zenput); readiness checklists, food-safety protocols, task management, and operational visibility
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: enterprise
- Evidence type: customer story
- Confidence: 95%
- Confidence rationale: The vendor-authored customer spotlight quotes Panera's VP of Operations Standards & Growth Initiatives naming the Zenput daily agenda, explicitly says Panera uses Crunchtime Operations Execution, and describes coverage across more than 2,200 U.S. cafes.
- Source title: How Panera Bread Drives Customer Loyalty and Empowers Teams
- Source URL: https://www.crunchtime.com/blog/customer-spotlight-how-panera-bread-drives-customer-loyalty-and-empowers-teams
- Publisher or source owner: Crunchtime
- Published date, if known: 2025-09-25
- Accessed date: 2026-09-21
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Panera's operations executive describes a Zenput daily readiness agenda, while Crunchtime says the Operations Execution solution standardizes food safety, automates task management, and provides real-time operational visibility across more than 2,200 cafes.
- Product-specific evidence: Crunchtime Operations Execution / Zenput daily agenda, food-safety standardization, automated task management, and real-time visibility.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor-authored story; the stated network size is over 2,200 U.S. cafes, while a July 2025 webinar preview on the same vendor site says nearly 4,000 cafes in ten countries. These figures appear to use different geographic scope and should not be treated as a contradiction without additional context.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a Panera-controlled technology statement or implementation artifact confirming current global versus U.S. scope.

### Observation 2

- Brand: Texas Roadhouse brand family
- Vendor: Crunchtime
- Product or category: Learning Live mobile training and development platform
- Relationship indication: customer
- Deployment scope: enterprise
- Evidence type: customer story
- Confidence: 85%
- Confidence rationale: The Crunchtime-hosted case-style article describes product workflows, named reporting capabilities, in-store iPad usage, nearly 90,000 employees across 650 locations, and a reported 70% increase in on-time LTO training completion.
- Source title: Texas Roadhouse Sees 70% Increase in Training Completions
- Source URL: https://www.crunchtime.com/blog/texas-roadhouse-sees-70-increase-in-training-completions
- Publisher or source owner: Crunchtime
- Published date, if known: 2024-02-05
- Accessed date: 2026-09-21
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The page says Learning Live is central to Texas Roadhouse training, describes automated learning paths and Exam Response Reports, and reports use across a 650-location brand family including Jaggers and Bubba's 33.
- Product-specific evidence: Learning Live mobile app, targeted content triggers, automated learning paths, micro-learning search, Exam Response Report, and in-store iPad access.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor-authored; the 650-location figure covers the wider brand family, so it should not be read as 650 Texas Roadhouse restaurants specifically. Current 2026 installed scope was not independently verified.
- Recommended follow-up: Find a current Texas Roadhouse-controlled training or technology source and separate each brand's location scope.

### Observation 3

- Brand: SONIC
- Vendor: Restaurant365
- Product or category: Accounting and restaurant operations platform, including POS integrations, P&L and AvT reporting, AP automation, inventory, purchasing, and multi-entity support
- Relationship indication: unknown
- Deployment scope: franchisee
- Evidence type: webinar
- Confidence: 35%
- Confidence rationale: Restaurant365 markets a SONIC-owner/operator-specific webinar and says its account executive supports SONIC owner/operators transitioning to the platform. This indicates at least some franchisee transition activity, but no owner/operator, location count, contract, implementation, or production deployment is named.
- Source title: SONIC's Guide to R365: Centralizing Accounting and Operations
- Source URL: https://www.restaurant365.com/webinars/recorded-webinars/sonics-guide-to-r365-centralizing-accounting-and-operations/
- Publisher or source owner: Restaurant365
- Published date, if known: Unknown; the page lists March 20 without a year and references planning for 2025 and beyond.
- Accessed date: 2026-09-21
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The webinar is designed for SONIC owner/operators nationwide and describes R365 accounting and operations capabilities; its speaker biography says the R365 account executive supports enterprise clients, including SONIC owner/operators, in transitioning to the platform.
- Product-specific evidence: Micros and Infor POS integration, automated P&L and actual-versus-theoretical reporting, invoice/AP automation, inventory and purchase-order management, and multi-entity/location support.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: This is a sales webinar rather than a named customer case study. It cannot support a SONIC enterprise relationship or quantify deployed franchisee locations.
- Recommended follow-up: Find a named SONIC franchisee case study, implementation announcement, customer quote, or technical integration artifact.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: Crunchtime's July 2025 Panera/CAVA webinar preview establishes that Panera uses Crunchtime.
- Pages checked: https://www.crunchtime.com/blog/webinar-preview-how-cava-and-panera-bread-drive-market-share-through-guest-experience
- Result: The preview names Panera and CAVA speakers and says they will discuss people, processes, and tools, but it does not name a Crunchtime product or assert that either brand is a customer. Retain it as event context only; the September customer spotlight supplies the actual relationship evidence.

## Source ledger

| URL | Source type | Accessed | Supports observation(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://www.crunchtime.com/blog/webinar-preview-how-cava-and-panera-bread-drive-market-share-through-guest-experience | webinar preview | 2026-09-21 | none | Names Panera and CAVA speakers but asserts no vendor-product deployment. |
| https://www.crunchtime.com/blog/customer-spotlight-how-panera-bread-drives-customer-loyalty-and-empowers-teams | customer story | 2026-09-21 | 1 | Strong Operations Execution / Zenput evidence across 2,200+ U.S. cafes. |
| https://www.crunchtime.com/blog/texas-roadhouse-sees-70-increase-in-training-completions | customer story | 2026-09-21 | 2 | Strong Learning Live evidence; 650-location figure covers a multi-brand family. |
| https://www.restaurant365.com/webinars/recorded-webinars/sonics-guide-to-r365-centralizing-accounting-and-operations/ | webinar | 2026-09-21 | 3 | Low-confidence franchisee transition indication, not enterprise deployment proof. |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: Panera's July webinar participation alone is not customer proof; the later product-specific story and executive quote are what raise confidence.
- Inference: SONIC-specific sales enablement is useful marketplace evidence at 35% confidence, but it must remain separate from a confirmed customer or installed-base claim.
